## Adding an app

- [ ] One file, `apps/<id>.json`, with `id` matching the filename
- [ ] The server declares a `ui://` resource with mimeType `text/html;profile=mcp-app`
- [ ] At least one tool carries `_meta.ui.resourceUri`
- [ ] `verification.status` reflects what was actually done
- [ ] `make verify` passes
